body.purpose: The only typographic voice — headings, body copy, labels, and channel card names. Heavier weights (700-800) stand in for a display face rather than a second font.

mono.purpose: Narrowed to genuinely monospace-appropriate content only: the playlist URL (profile form and topbar Source stat). No longer used as a technical-flavor voice for IDs, counts, or timestamps.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.value: 0 18px 36px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 45%, transparent), 0 0 22px -4px var(--color-accent-glow)
shadows.purpose: The signature hover/select treatment on channel cards — offset+blur drop shadow layered with an accent-tinted ring and glow.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: The welcome-screen form panel and channel-list panel's resting lift.

shadows.name: player-frame
shadows.purpose: The video player's resting shadow — larger than a card's since it is the dominant element.

motion.name: channel-card-hover
motion.purpose: The system's one authored signature moment: a lift (translateY(-4px) scale(1.015)) plus an accent-tinted glow appearing on hover/focus. Transform is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving only the shadow/border-color transition.

motion.name: card-select-pulse
motion.purpose: One-shot scale-settle when a channel card or the player frame becomes active/selected. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: Live/connecting status dot breathing pulse. Reduced to a static 0.85 opacity under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: btn-shimmer
motion.purpose: Loading sweep on the primary submit button. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The topbar's Source stat (a full playlist URL) hides below this width as a second line of defense; the topbar's flex-wrap is the primary containment mechanism at any width.

components.name: Channel Card
components.description: The primary browsable content unit — a rounded card with a soft violet-tinted gradient art area (logo or monogram) above a body carrying the channel name, category, and a status badge.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 168px; background: var(--color-card, #1f1f2a); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2b2b38); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03) inset; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.015); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #7c5cff) 55%, var(--color-border, #2b2b38)); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #7c5cff) 45%, transparent), 0 0 22px -4px rgba(124,92,255,0.35); } .ds-card--active { border-color: var(--color-accent, #7c5cff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-accent, #7c5cff), 0 18px 36px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.65); } .ds-card__art { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #7c5cff) 24%, var(--color-card-hover, #272733)) 0%, var(--color-card, #1f1f2a) 72%); } .ds-card__logo { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #a7a7b5); } .ds-card__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2b2b38); } .ds-card__name { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text, #f5f5f8); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-card__meta-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-card__category { font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-text-muted, #8c8c98); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-status--live { color: var(--color-accent-text, #a78bff); } .ds-status--live .ds-dot { background: var(--color-accent, #7c5cff); }

components.name: Status Badge (connecting)
components.description: The dot-plus-label status pattern, reused identically on channel cards and the video player.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status--connecting { color: var(--color-warning, #fbbf24); } .ds-status--connecting .ds-dot { background: var(--color-warning, #fbbf24); animation: ds-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status--connecting .ds-dot { animation: none; opacity: 0.85; } }

components.name: Category Pill
components.description: The category-navigation unit in a horizontally-scrollable pill bar. Active pill fills solid with the committed accent; inactive pills sit on the surface color. No per-category color-coding.
components.css: .ds-pill { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2b2b38); background: var(--color-surface, #1b1b25); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #a7a7b5); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #3c3c4c); color: var(--color-text, #f5f5f8); } .ds-pill--active { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #6c46f0); border-color: var(--color-accent-strong, #6c46f0); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(124,92,255,0.35); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #7c5cff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committed accent's solid-fill button — deeper accent-strong shade for AA contrast with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; background: var(--color-accent-strong, #6c46f0); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #7c5cff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #7c5cff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Utility action — surface fill, uppercase-free label, accent border on hover (danger on the 'Switch profile' variant).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-surface, #1b1b25); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #3c3c4c); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #a7a7b5); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; transition: border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent, #7c5cff); color: var(--color-text, #f5f5f8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #7c5cff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Ink fill, hairline border, focus adds both a border color shift and a soft accent ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #a7a7b5); } .ds-field__input { background: var(--color-bg, #121218); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2b2b38); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--color-text, #f5f5f8); caret-color: var(--color-accent-text, #a78bff); } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted, #8c8c98); } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-accent, #7c5cff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #7c5cff) 16%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Banner
components.description: Error and notice tones sharing one shape; error uses role="alert"/aria-live="assertive", notice uses role="status"/aria-live="polite".
components.html: Couldn't load the playlist. Check the URL and try again.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-banner--error { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger, #fb7185) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger, #fb7185) 16%, transparent); color: var(--color-danger, #fb7185); } .ds-banner--notice { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #7c5cff) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #7c5cff) 16%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent-text, #a78bff); }

narrative.overview: OpenTV replaces its prior broadcast-control-room identity ("MCR Video Wall" — bezels, tally lights, UMD nameplates, a patch-bay category rail) with the vocabulary every mainstream streaming/IPTV app already speaks: rounded, browsable channel cards on a warm dark ground, a horizontally-scrollable pill bar for category browsing, and one saturated, committed accent color that carries real visual weight instead of hiding in restraint. The structural proportions the previous system got right — a dominant video player above a compact, horizontally-scrolling strip of channel units — are kept unchanged; only the visual language around that structure is new.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal dark ground (#121218), not an ink-cold engineering black — a living-room-at-night surface
One committed accent, Signal Violet (#7c5cff), carrying real weight: primary buttons, the active category pill, the selected/live channel state, and focus rings — not a decorative sliver
Rounded channel cards (16px radius) with a soft violet-tinted radial gradient behind each logo, since there is no real poster art to show
A horizontally-scrollable category pill bar between the topbar and the player — no fixed-width sidebar, so category browsing can never overlap adjacent content at any window width
Status is always a dot + an uppercase text label together, never color alone

rules.name: The Committed Accent Rule
rules.body: --color-accent (in its strong/text/soft forms) is the one color the interface spends real weight on — buttons, active states, live/selected state, focus. It is allowed to carry real visual weight across the interface, as long as it stays the only competing hue doing so.

rules.name: The Dot-Plus-Label Rule
rules.body: No status is ever conveyed by a dot color alone — every .status-badge pairs a colored dot with an uppercase text label in the same hue family.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Manrope is the only font making a typographic identity statement. Weight and size carry hierarchy; there is no second display face standing in for brand character.

dos: Do pair every status indicator with a text label — never rely on dot color alone (The Dot-Plus-Label Rule).
Do let the committed accent carry real visual weight across buttons, active states, and focus rings.
Do reach for flex-wrap with min-width: 0 and truncate on any row of variable-width content before a fixed grid or hidden-below-breakpoint pattern.
Do keep the connecting/offline status hues functional and distinct from the committed accent.
donts: Don't use a colored border-left/border-right on cards, rows, or alerts (project-wide craft-floor rule).
Don't reintroduce per-category color-coding — it competes with the committed accent and doesn't scale past a handful of categories.
Don't use IBM Plex Mono as a technical-flavor voice for anything that isn't genuinely a URL or similarly measured value.
Don't cap a variable-width content row at a fixed height or fixed-column grid without a wrap/reflow path.
